title: 第十一章李长寿 死道友不死贫道第十二章梁国皇城掌上明珠
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 城中无数修士均是为这股战斗余波赶来。
修仙界也充斥着严重的尔虞我诈。
例如其他修士一旦发生争斗，他们就会迅速赶来。
等到他们两败俱伤，或者是一方有所陨落，那就是他们捡漏的时候。
曾经可是有着一名金丹真人在梁国陨落，一名筑基巅峰侥幸捡到了他的乾坤戒，从而突破到金丹。
正是出现了这件事，这才助长了这股气焰。
李长寿的行为无疑是苟到了极致。
就在他们回到房间不久，周围便传出凄厉的惨叫声。
顺着源头正是那一家邻居，是李长寿做过手脚的那家。
好在这些修士察觉到源头至宝消失，没有滥杀周围无辜，选择了离开这里。
躲在房间中李长寿这才松了口气。
“这次出手风险不小，好在收获也不小。”
李长寿看着楚玉璃那娇滴滴的俏脸，顿时觉得自己太老六了。
明明是王麻子嫉妒他的女人，自己不但杀了他，还反其道而行之。
“难怪都喜欢当曹贼，原来这么爽！”
楚玉璃察觉到李长寿的目光，脸唰的一下就红了，放在大腿上的两只小手缩了缩。
那唯唯诺诺的样子让李长寿哭笑不得。
曾经这是受了多少委屈啊！
“多谢前辈出手，我既然已经答应您的要求，定然会好好侍奉您。”
“进了这个家门，没有那么多规矩。”李长寿摆了摆手，笑道：“我叫李长寿，从此叫我长寿就好。”
即便李长寿说了，楚玉璃仍旧唯唯诺诺，显然是还没有适应。
在他的执意要求下，楚玉璃这才扭扭捏捏的喊出了他的名字。
“长寿，你以后会和王麻子一样打我吗？”楚玉璃抓起李长寿的衣角，鼓起勇气说道。
“当然不会，你可是我的女人，我怎么忍心下得了手。”
经过甜言蜜语，楚玉璃的好感度从10%提升到了60%。
这种程度的跃升大大超出李长寿的预料。
他本来还以为楚玉璃有着悲伤的过往，想要把她从里面拉回来，少说需要数日的时间。
按照这样的发展，只怕要不了多久自己就可以获得系统奖励了。
“长寿，这位姐姐真的没事吗？”
苏千凡经过王麻子的迷烟，至今还处于昏迷状态。
李长寿早已用烈火剑帮她将毒素驱除，并无任何大碍。
只不过这种毒素极其恐怖，想要苏醒至少也得需要一天的时间。
“放心，千凡早已无碍，睡一觉就好了。”
李长寿双目盯着楚玉璃，这让她一时间有些羞耻。
她也是女人，明白李长寿这是在暗示她。
“既然是夫君所想，今晚就让玉璃来侍奉你吧！”
‘真是怪哉，她怎么知道我心中所想。’
‘不对，准确来说是楚玉璃比较上道，居然已经开始解衣带了。’
苏千凡正在沉睡，李长寿也不好再打扰，只能默默给她盖上了被子，和楚玉璃退出了房间。
两人来到另一处房间，径直地来到床榻上。
今天可是纳妾的日子，事发突然加上外面有修士肆意穿梭，只能办得简单一些。
李长寿在桌子上摆放了几个红色的蜡烛，酒壶，酒杯...
content_en:
Countless monks in the city came because of the aftermath of the battle.
The world of immortality is also full of serious intrigues.
For example, if there is a fight between other monks, they will come quickly.
When both of them suffer losses, or one party falls, that's when they make a mistake.
There once was a golden elixir master who fell in the Liang Kingdom, and a peak-level foundation-builder luckily picked up his Qiankun Ring, thus breaking through to the golden elixir.
It was the occurrence of this incident that fueled this arrogance.
Li Changshou's behavior was undoubtedly to the extreme.
Not long after they returned to the room, screams could be heard from around them.
Following the source was the neighbor, the one where Li Changshou had done something.
Fortunately, these monks noticed the disappearance of the source treasure and did not kill the innocent people around them indiscriminately. They chose to leave here.
Li Changshou, who was hiding in the room, breathed a sigh of relief.
"The risk of this move is not small, but the reward is not small either."
Li Changshou looked at Chu Yuli's pretty face and suddenly felt that he was too old.
It was clearly Wang Mazi who was jealous of his woman, so he not only killed him, but also did the opposite.
"No wonder everyone likes to be a thief, it's so fun!"
Chu Yuli noticed Li Changshou's gaze, her face suddenly turned red, and her two small hands on her thighs shrank.
That submissive look made Li Changshou dumbfounded.
How much grievances have I suffered!
"Thank you for your help, senior. Since I have agreed to your request, I will definitely serve you well."
"There are not so many rules when you enter this family." Li Changshou waved his hand and said with a smile: "My name is Li Changshou, just call me Changshou from now on."
Even though Li Changshou said it, Chu Yuli was still obedient, obviously she hadn't adapted yet.
At his insistent request, Chu Yuli coyly called out his name.
"Chou Changshou, will you beat me like Wang Mazi in the future?" Chu Yuli grabbed the corner of Li Changshou's clothes and summoned up the courage to say.
"Of course not, you are my woman, how could I bear to do it."
After sweet talk, Chu Yuli's favorability increased from 10% to 60%.
This level of jump greatly exceeded Li Changshou's expectations.
He originally thought that Chu Yuli had a sad past, and it would take several days at least to bring her back from it.
According to this development, I'm afraid it won't be long before I can get system rewards.
"Longevity, is this sister really okay?"
Su Qianfan passed through Wang Mazi's smoke and is still in a coma.
Li Changshou had already used the Fiery Sword to help her get rid of the toxins, and there was no serious problem.
It's just that this toxin is extremely terrifying, and it will take at least a day to wake up.
"Don't worry, Qianfan is already fine, just have a sleep and he'll be fine."
Li Changshou stared at Chu Yuli, which made her feel a little ashamed for a moment.
She is also a woman and understands that Li Changshou is hinting at her.
"Since this is what my husband wants, let Yuli serve you tonight!"
'It's strange how she knows what I'm thinking. ’
'No, to be precise, Chu Yuli is more sophisticated and has actually started to take off her clothes. ’
Su Qianfan was sleeping, and Li Changshou couldn't disturb her anymore, so he could only cover her with a quilt silently, and exited the room with Chu Yuli.
The two of them came to another room and went straight to the bed.
Today is the day for concubinage. The sudden incident and the monks running around outside made it easier to do so.
Li Changshou placed several red candles, wine bottles, wine glasses on the table...
